einzeiler: A 22-year-old factory worker was murdered after unknowingly getting caught in a bizarre…
kurzfassung: In September 2006, 22-year-old Brian Barrett was shot and killed outside his New York factory. Investigators discovered he had been drawn into an online love triangle involving a coworker, Tom Montgomery, and a young woman named Jesse. It was later revealed that "Jesse" was actually Mary Sheeler, a mother in her late forties using her teenage daughter's photos to catfish men.
stichpunkte: Brian Barrett was found shot to death in his truck outside the Dynabraid factory in September 2006.
Investigators found thousands of messages on Brian's computer exchanged with a young woman named Jesse on the gaming platform Pogo.
Tom Montgomery, Brian's 45-year-old coworker and married father, was also deeply entangled in an online relationship with Jesse.
Tom grew intensely jealous and enraged when Brian began pursuing a relationship with Jesse.
Police gathered evidence against Tom, including DNA on a peach pit at the crime scene and matching rifle records.

Following his arrest, the true identity of Jesse was uncovered: she was actually Mary Sheeler, a woman in her late forties who had been catfishing men using her 18-year-old daughter's photos and name.
Tom Montgomery pleaded guilty to first-degree manslaughter and was sentenced to 20 years in prison before eventually being paroled.
Mary Sheeler faced no criminal charges for the catfishing operation, though her husband filed for divorce upon learning the truth.
beschreibung:
In September of 2006, a 22-year-old man finished his shift in New York factory and walked outside toward his truck. Minutes later, he was dead. At first, investigators were faced with the murder of a young man who seemingly had little reason to be targeted. But as they began looking into Brian’s life, they uncovered a bizarre online love triangle involving a coworker, a young woman known only by a screen name, and a web of secret identities where almost no one was who they claimed to be. This is Talhotblond: The Murder of Brian Barrett.
